question:
**In the given sentence, identify the segment which contains a grammatical error.**

The migrating labourers were served hot meals for every town or village on their way.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **for every town**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Replace the preposition **for **with **by** to make the sentence correct.
 
• "For"<
